_meta: Initial seed: the 10 practices from AWS Well-Architected + Google SRE most relevant to Aerial (an agent-ops platform). status/evidence are filled by the gap analysis (gap.run_gap_analysis) against the decision-point checks.

practices.statement: Recover automatically from failures: detect, respond, and recover without human intervention wherever possible.
practices.evidence: check bp.failure.autorecovery: failure-flow state machine (D3) drives scoped recovery

practices.statement: No single point of failure: a component's failure must degrade, not take the platform down.
practices.evidence: check bp.failure.autorecovery on fallback placement: GLM depends on one host (Ariel); no documented failover seat

practices.statement: Perform operations as code: all operational decisions executed through reviewed, versioned scripts and config.
practices.evidence: check bp.change.auditable: ops run through governed scripts; every model call logged

practices.statement: Anticipate failure: run game days / adversarial exercises against the live design.
practices.evidence: check bp.failure.classified plus attack-swarm: sandboxed parallel adversarial runs (attack_run.py) with findings routed through the followup classifier

practices.statement: Attribute and budget consumption per unit of work; enforce budgets, do not just observe them.
practices.evidence: check bp.cost.budgeted: per-call token budgets with need = input + max_tokens + 5% margin

practices.statement: Apply least privilege: separate identities for agent vs. human operations; agents never handle raw credentials.
practices.evidence: check bp.security.least_privilege: agents run as service users; ray/admin kept separate; credential handling forbidden

practices.statement: Enable traceability: log and audit every action that changes state.
practices.evidence: check bp.change.auditable: model-call log (role, server, tokens, timings, verdict) + kanban event log

practices.statement: Alert on symptoms, not causes: the operator sees user-visible degradation, not internal metric noise.
practices.evidence: check bp.alert.symptoms: daily exec report surfaces agent actions, failures, and gaps — no live-watch panes

practices.statement: Blameless postmortems: every incident produces a written finding with root cause and followup actions.
practices.evidence: check bp.failure.classified: failures are classified R1-R6 and routed, but no written postmortem artifact per incident

practices.statement: Define service-level objectives and error budgets before taking reliability risks.
practices.evidence: check bp.alert.symptoms: no SLOs defined for agent-ops surfaces yet — wire from decision-points.md (D4-D12 pending)
